summary.text: Shelly Boshart Davis is a Republican state representative from Oregon House District 15 who took office in 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Joanna Robinson as her general-election opponent.

paragraphs.text: Boshart Davis earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from Oregon State University.
She is the owner of Boshart Trucking and has been vice president of international sales at BOSSCO Trading.

Her affiliations include the Linn County Budget Committee, an Oregon Department of Transportation technical advisory committee, the Albany Area Chamber of Commerce Governmental Affairs Committee and the Linn County Farm Bureau.
Boshart Davis assumed office in 2019, succeeding Andy Olson, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
For 2023-2024, Ballotpedia lists her as co-vice chair of the Joint Transportation Committee and a member of the Business and Labor Committee and the Joint Interstate 5 Bridge Committee.
